manifest.population: 24 fresh complete coordination pairs, balanced eight each across repeated-wide, fronted-narrow, and determiner-doubled-narrow repairs; settlement is aggregate-only to match the target original
manifest.selection: All pairs, modifier classes, repairs, complete-line renderings, and equal stratum weights were authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure. No target manifest was opened. Every pair is a different-input test of one registered repair against the corresponding live-boundary bare coordination; fixed compounds, type-clash carve-outs, and already-marked second conjuncts are excluded because the convention does not trigger there. The `stratum` labels remain descriptive item metadata only; the target original has no manifest-bound settlement strata.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)). Average all 24 items equally. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable aggregate headline; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. Repair-group means are diagnostic only and carry no settlement weight because the target original is aggregate-only. File every finite result exactly once regardless of agreement, sign, or effect on the proposal.

estimand.population: the 24 frozen different-input live-boundary coordination pairs
estimand.aggregation: equal-item aggregate mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean; item stratum labels diagnostic only
estimand.comparator: the corresponding refused bare modifier-plus-coordination surface
